headword: {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}
gloss: health management; taking care of one's health

definitions.gloss: health management; taking care of one's physical condition
definitions.explanation: The practice of monitoring and maintaining one's physical health through proper diet, sleep, exercise, and lifestyle habits. A concept frequently emphasized in Japanese workplaces and schools.

examples.japanese: {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}に{気|き}をつけてください。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

examples.japanese: {社会人|しゃかいじん}にとって{体調管理|たいちょうかんり}は{基本|きほん}だ。
examples.english: Health management is fundamental for working adults.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}は{特|とく}に{体調管理|たいちょうかんり}をしっかりして、{万全|ばんぜん}の{状態|じょうたい}で{臨|のぞ}みたい。
examples.english: Especially before exams, I want to manage my health carefully and face them in top condition.

notes:
CULTURE:
{体調管理|たいちょうかんり} is considered a personal responsibility in Japanese society. In workplaces, employees are expected to manage their own health so as not to burden colleagues. The phrase {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}も{仕事|しごと}のうち (health management is part of the job) reflects this cultural attitude.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}に{気|き}をつける (to pay attention to one's health)
- {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}を{徹底|てってい}する (to be thorough about health management)
- {体調管理|たいちょうかんり}が{大切|たいせつ} (health management is important)
